operationalRecovery.message: The baseline cursor included reviewer setup events and returned same_agent/same_work_item routes.
The reviewer intent was recorded before its worktree graph was ready, so no impact_result route was emitted.
The runner used unsupported context artifact kind review_result; the existing verification kind was required.
A stable predecessor agent session expired while sequential join/readiness work was still in progress.
A stable predecessor agent session still expired during the bounded run; concurrent joins and persistent heartbeats were then added.
